about: Receiving-water names in Alabama's reports (ADEM's SSO report layer, every report since 2012 read on 2026-11-07, and the waters ADEM names for its coastal beach monitoring stations) that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for AL, by name as the ingester reads it from the report's words (spellings that differ only in case, spaces or punctuation counted together), with the number of reports giving each and up to five of their points. Reports that say the sewage reached no water, or name only a storm drain or ditch, are left out; so are reports marked as duplicates of another.
